mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collect (user_id, user_collect_id, relic_object_id, relic_name) VALUES (#{uid}, #{rid}, #{relicObjectId}, #{relicName})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM collect WHERE user_id=#{uid} and user_collect_id=#{rid}
SELECT * FROM collect WHERE user_id=#{uid} and relic_object_id=#{objectId} LIMIT 1

SELECT collect.id as id, collect.user_id as uid, collect.user_collect_id as rid, user.user_name as username, COALESCE(cultural_relics_data.object_name, collect.relic_name) as relicname, collect.relic_object_id as relicObjectId FROM collect INNER JOIN user ON collect.user_id = user.user_id LEFT JOIN cultural_relics_data ON collect.user_collect_id = cultural_relics_data.id WHERE collect.user_id = #{uid}
